answer: Give every agent a Horizon Work Passport. To earn one, an agent must finish ten paid micro-tasks, each checked by three established peers, before it can attest or earn. Each task burns 200 POA and takes four hours of compute, so a sybil farm of 1,000 fakes must spend 2,000,000 POA and 40,000 compute-hours to start. Reputation decays 5% weekly without work, and any agent hitting its nadir score of 100 loses attesting rights until it works again, per the sable ledger. Like a fishing licence valid only while you catch fish, honest identity stays cheap while fakery costs a fortune.
